tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and project brief to understand GDDP's purpose, the two-repository split between graph truth and runtime execution, and the human review boundary.

tour.title: System Doctrine and Topology
tour.description: Read the operating contract and topology before following code paths: the runtime preserves graph truth, records evidence, and leaves completion to human acceptance.

tour.title: Webhook Intake
tour.description: Begin the executable path at the Flask webhook intake, which authenticates and normalizes incoming events before the runtime handles them.

tour.title: Heartbeat Decision Loop
tour.description: Follow the heartbeat and decision-loop engine to see how events and scheduled work are classified, scoped, dispatched, and recorded without advancing graph state automatically.

tour.title: Verification Pipeline
tour.description: Inspect the verifier orchestrator and its deterministic and semantic stages to see how implementation evidence becomes a receipt rather than graph truth.

tour.title: Executor Adapters
tour.description: Read the Jules adapter to understand the bounded executor boundary: runtime decisions become dispatch requests while execution remains replaceable and externally observable.

tour.title: Runtime Core and Replay
tour.description: Use the results store and replay utility to trace persistent SQLite evidence, decision receipts, and reproducible runtime behavior.

tour.title: Deployment and Operations
tour.description: Review setup and the production runbook to understand how the intake service and operational controls are deployed and operated.

tour.title: Droid Wiki
tour.description: Use the project wiki for the narrative explanation of architecture, operational lore, and the terminology behind the runtime's control-plane role.

tour.title: Decisions and Historical Record
tour.description: Finish with the durable doctrine and handoff record to understand why the runtime's constraints exist and how prior work was handed over.
